title: P2 principal.offboard: request
description: A person leaves for good: the state offboarded, which no operation leaves, deletion of the links of their channel identities, and an erasure request by the scope (tenant, subject) with the reason offboarding; a principal_left notice to the admins (IDN-13). All of this exists since v0.1 (LCY-8, D-98, MEM-4, RET-7, PRM-14); by the rule LCY-3, since v0.2 offboarding also publishes principal.offboarded. The body is the same in both versions.

subject.description: The principal who leaves: an opaque id human:p_<ULID> (a training handle in fixtures).
